origin: Mark, attended 2026-10-20 (ledger D-99): "another strand is we could have more impressive textures for the stars/sun - we are dimming them anyway, so we can see structure?"
external_dependencies: sunholo/celestial 0.5.0 (new module stellar; publish on Mark's go)
velocity: about 1,600 LOC over 8.5 working days (about 190 LOC/day; recent attended rate about 300)

pause_points.mark_decides: the look at each stop (dev build, Auto view)

questions_for_mark.q: Honest resolution gate or exaggerate structure everywhere?
Procedural in the shader or a texture baked per star at arrival?
questions_for_mark.recommendation: procedural unless the bench at the SS2 midpoint misses +0.5 ms; then a cube map baked at arrival, decided before the pause

questions_for_mark.q: Keep each star's total light fixed, or let spots dim it by the real ~0.1%?
Supergranulation (invisible in white light): leave out or show faintly?
Eclipse layers now or with the D-96 framing doc?
An Archive entry explaining what the player sees?
Diamond ring: the starfield's PSF bloom on an occulted photospheric sliver only (D-59 stays for the forward view), or a bare bead?
questions_for_mark.recommendation: allow it for the sliver only

questions_for_mark.q: Structure in the Auto view only; Realistic stays a clipped white disc (D-59). Right?

features.description: verify and pin every cited number (paper, page/table, Teff and log g coverage; a cool-dwarf LD table for TRAPPIST-1 and Barnard, never a clamp); record under citations

sunholo/celestial 0.5.0 module stellar: LD laws (linear, quadratic, Claret-4) and means, ldCoeffs table (Claret & Bloemen 2011), scale-height/cell size, granulation and spot temperature contrasts, differential rotation (Snodgrass & Ulrich 1990), Baumbach corona, lineColour; tests with cited check values; probe into tests/test_physics.gd; stop before publish

log g per finite star with provenance; surfaceOf(star, seed) in sim/core.ail; protocol 2.13 surface object (additive); pin celestial 0.5.0; strict, parity, replay; the clock check from the sim's own t - light_age_s (D never applied again); mk/star-surfaces.mk with stellar-protocol-test and star-surface-test in test:, stellar-protocol-test in ci-fast

physics/star_surface.gd CPU mirror; bb LUT bound for every star disc; per-element colour; LD laws for limb_u-0 stars (the Sun keeps linear 0.6, bit-identical); temperature map + resolution gate; cached flux normaliser (64x64 quadrature, <=50 ms, <=1/s); float64-reduced phases; SystemView uniforms and fader peak; ray_colour; goldens G-SS-1..5 and the count pin 393 -> 398; bench at the midpoint reproducing bh_ship_bench's sky GPU reading; captures; delete spike/star_surfaces; dev build pause

corona (Baumbach), H-alpha chromosphere and prominences with lineColour (black outside 360-830 nm), occlusion from SystemView, _displayed_peak = visible peak blended by the uncovered fraction (global k unchanged), a real eclipse sim state, captures
Archive entry (attended), inspector labels, report, changelog, design-repo PR merged, rig make test, independent evaluation; merge blocked until sunholo/celestial 0.5.0 is published and locked
